motivation.mechanism: Sustained range expansion may persist long enough for a slow channel exit to overcome all-taker costs.
motivation.positive_prior: Slow hourly SOL trend evidence and HYPE alignment evidence suggest persistence can exist in asset-specific slices.
motivation.negative_prior: UT flips, small ROE ratchets, and completed-4h SMA crosses failed out of sample or after largest-winner removal.
motivation.testable_change: Require a fresh completed-4h breakout of the prior 20-bar channel, retain the position until a prior 10-bar counter-channel exit or structural stop, and do not use a fixed target.

chronology.opening_rule: Open development only. Open each validation once only when its development group clears aggregate stress and largest-winner criteria without parameter changes.

support_criteria: group nominal and stress net PnL and profit factor exceed zero and one
group nominal and stress net remain positive after the single largest winner is removed
both long and short trades occur in the group
no-lookahead, append-invariance, gap reset, timing, exit, and fixed-risk sizing tests pass
shared-account concurrency simulation passes before live authority
falsifiers: development or validation group nominal or stress expectancy is non-positive
development or validation group depends on the largest winner
a future bar changes a prior entry, exit, stop, or size
a channel includes the current decision bar
any completed-4h decision is executed before its close
parameters are changed after viewing V75 returns
